title: Smart Insurance Coverage for Modern Vacation Rentals
summary: Smart Insurance Coverage for Modern Vacation Rentals
body_markdown:
Property management is more sophisticated than ever. Today’s leading property managers are no longer juggling spreadsheets and sticky notes—they’re running their businesses through advanced Property Management Systems (PMS) that centralize reservations, housekeeping schedules, guest communications, and team coordination. For many, the PMS is the single source of truth that keeps operations streamlined and profitable.


As PMS providers look to deepen their value to busy PMCs, one opportunity stands out: embedding smart, white-label insurance solutions directly into their platforms.


## Why White-Label Insurance is a Game-Changer for PMS Platforms


Insurance is one of the most critical yet confusing aspects of vacation rental management. Property managers want peace of mind, but they often struggle to navigate a maze of policies, exclusions, and coverage limits. By integrating white-label insurance solutions, PMS providers can transform an administrative burden into a brand-enhancing service.


Here’s why it matters:


- Time and trust are priceless:


Managers already trust their PMS as the hub of their business. Offering insurance through that trusted platform removes friction and makes coverage part of their day-to-day workflow.
- White-labeling enhances your brand:


Positioning the coverage under your brand reinforces your role as the property manager’s strategic partner—not just a software vendor.
- Strengthening Your Relationships:


White-labeling insurance is a powerful way to deliver on the needs of your PMCs. You’re already viewed as their go-to resource, why not help them make the process of buying insurance easier and more intuitive?


## The “Smart” Approach to Embedded Coverage


Not all insurance is created equal. Smart PMS providers look for coverage that meets real-world property manager needs while enhancing platform loyalty. Consider these three key criteria:


- **Protection Property Managers Actually Want**
Think beyond standard liability coverage. Policies that include bed bug remediation and linen or excess cleaning resonate with managers because they address high-frequency headaches that traditional homeowners or commercial policies ignore.
- **Flexibility for Your User Base**
Short-term rental portfolios vary widely. Look for solutions that can scale with different property types, reservation models, and coverage tiers. Products like SmartSTR™ Insurance offer coverage that addresses the challenges property managers face daily.
- **Expertise You Can Trust**
Insurance is reputation-sensitive. Work with providers who understand the short-term rental market, have a customer-first mindset, and can ensure your embedded offerings meet local and industry standards.


## How SmartSTR™ Insurance Fits the Market


Tint’s SmartSTR™ Insurance is purpose-built for modern vacation rentals. It offers:


- **Tiered Property Damage Coverage** up to $50,000 with a no deductible or claim minimum on contents
- **Bed Bug Infestation Protection** up to $15,000, including remediation costs and limited revenue replacement, with no maximum limits set by bedroom size.
- **General and Real Property Liability Coverage** up to $1,000,000 per claim
- **Fast claims turnaround** , with payments typically within five business days after providing what account you would like your payment deposited.
- For PMS providers, embedding SmartSTR™ through a white-label solution means your users get best-in-class protection without leaving the platform they already trust to run their business.


## Elevate Your PMS with Embedded Insurance


Vacation rental management is competitive, and PMS platforms that become indispensable will lead the market. By embedding smart, white-labeled insurance coverage, you’re not just helping managers protect their properties—you’re helping them operate with confidence and efficiency.
When your platform makes insurance simple, transparent, and branded as part of your ecosystem, you become more than software. You become the partner that drives peace of mind, profitability, and loyalty.
